item.title: security: Advance Zero Trust for AI: New tools and guidance to secure AI agents and DevSecOps
item.description:
Microsoft says it is expanding its Zero Trust for AI strategy with new tools and guidance aimed at securing AI agents and DevSecOps environments. The post highlights a broader security approach for AI and related development workflows.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
